title: Rejection Reason
description: One Rejection Reason, a part shared by the Order Answer, the Rejection Email and the Order Desk Notification. Trailhead Gear owns it.

orderCheck.description: Order Check that failed (UC-003). Absent for a request that cannot be read as a Partner Order, UC-001 A3.

lineNumber.description: Order Line the reason refers to, when it refers to one, UC-003 BR-010.

text.description: The Rejection Reason, readable by a person: the failed check and what to change. Names no Customer, email address or Shipping Address (C-023).
